solutions.title: Serialize with null markers
solutions.strategy: Serialize both trees with null markers and search for the subtree serialization.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each tree is serialized once and substring search is linear for these built strings.

solutions.title: DFS tree match
solutions.strategy: At every root candidate, recursively compare both trees for exact structure and values.

timeComplexity.explanation: In the worst case many candidate roots compare much of the subtree.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Recursive traversal depth follows tree height.
